summary.key_theme: Amazon 憑藉 AWS 強勁成長、AI 領域的策略性投資與創新應用，持續獲得市場分析師與機構的長期看好。

bullish.title: Amazon Price Prediction: The Stock’s Path Toward $300 Looks Clearer
bullish.reason: 分析師指出 AWS 成長速度創五年新高，加上廣告業務獲利能力強勁，支撐股價上看 300 美元。

bullish.title: Qualcomm Lost Apple’s Modem Business. Amazon Just Offered a $60 Billion Escape Route.
bullish.reason: Amazon 與 Qualcomm 達成重大合作，預計帶來 600 億美元的潛在商業價值，強化硬體生態系。

bullish.title: Amazon adds cybersecurity veteran Kevin Mandia to board 2 years after he left Google
bullish.reason: 延攬資安專家 Kevin Mandia 加入董事會，有助於強化雲端業務的資安防護與企業信任度。

bullish.title: Amazon’s Zoox Enters San Francisco’s Crowded Robotaxi Market
bullish.reason: 自動駕駛子公司 Zoox 擴大在舊金山的服務，展現 Amazon 在 AI 與無人駕駛領域的技術實力。

bullish.title: Binge watching and binge shopping come together: Amazon lets Prime viewers buy what characters wear
bullish.reason: 推出 AI 驅動的影視購物功能，將 Prime Video 與電商業務深度整合，有望提升轉換率。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer Names Amazon (AMZN) a “Sleep-at-Night Growth Stock”
bullish.reason: 知名財經評論員 Jim Cramer 將 Amazon 列為高成長且穩健的投資標的，增強市場信心。

bearish.title: Amazon Pauses Operations With 21 Air After Miami Crash
bearish.reason: 因空難事故暫停與 21 Air 的合作，短期內可能影響物流運能與供應鏈效率。

bearish.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Trimmed This Big Tech Position to Back These 2 AI Contenders
bearish.reason: 知名基金經理人 Bill Ackman 減持 Amazon 部位，轉而加碼 Microsoft 與 Meta，顯示資金配置調整。

bearish.title: UPS Cut Amazon Volumes on Purpose. The Margin Data Says It Worked.
bearish.reason: UPS 減少與 Amazon 的合作量以優化自身利潤，反映出 Amazon 在物流成本控制上可能面臨壓力。

neutral.title: Alibaba and Amazon Face the Same AI Spending Question: How Quickly Does Capacity Become Cash?
neutral.reason: 探討 AI 資本支出轉化為營收的效率問題，屬於產業長期觀察議題，對股價無立即影響。

neutral.title: Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft: Which 2 to Buy and Which 1 to Avoid
neutral.reason: 針對大型科技股的比較分析，觀點中立，旨在提供投資組合建議。

neutral.title: Investing $20,000 in Apple Stock 10 Years Ago Paid Off More Than Investing the Same Amount in Amazon
neutral.reason: 回顧過去十年的績效表現，屬於歷史數據分析，對未來股價走勢參考價值有限。

neutral.title: Amazon gives OpenAI's ad business a boost, letting its advertisers into ChatGPT
neutral.reason: Amazon 允許廣告主進入 ChatGPT，此舉雖具創新性，但對整體營收貢獻尚不明確。
